## Account summary

## What happened
July performance softened versus June: spend fell 1.4%, impressions 0.9%, clicks 0.5%, conversions 4.5%, and revenue 1.5%, while cost per conversion rose 3.2%. No campaigns were flagged in the provided evidence, so the review prioritizes the largest movers. ## Why
Observed evidence: the account lost conversion volume faster than spend, which pushed total CPA higher. The clearest efficiency deterioration was in Advantage+ - Catalog, where spend and traffic grew about 6.8% but conversions fell 8.3% and CPA rose 16.5%. Demand Gen - Trial and Retargeting - 30d also showed lower conversions and lower revenue, while Search - Non-brand added traffic without a conversion lift. Use July as a reallocation and diagnostic checkpoint. Protect or cautiously scale the better-performing areas, especially Prospecting - Broad and Search - Brand, but only after the diagnostic checks above confirm the drivers. ## What happened
